name: toc
description: Phone notifications (via ntfy) when Claude Code finishes a task, asks a question, needs permission or stops with an error.

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: Topic your phone subscribes to in the ntfy app. On the public server anyone who knows the name reads your notifications, so use a long random name, such as the output of: python -c "import secrets; print('toc-' + secrets.token_hex(16))". Use the same topic on all your computers.

ntfy_server.title: ntfy server
ntfy_server.description: ntfy server URL. Change it only if you run your own server.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token (optional)
ntfy_token.description: Access token (tk_...) for a protected topic: your own ntfy server, or a reserved topic on an ntfy.sh account. Stored in the system credential store.

python_command.title: Python command (optional)
python_command.description: Leave empty to detect it automatically (python3, python, py). Set it only if Python 3.9+ has another name on this computer.

device_name.title: Computer nickname
device_name.description: Name shown in the notification, such as Notebook or PC. Leave empty to use the hostname.

min_duration_seconds.title: Minimum duration (seconds)
min_duration_seconds.description: Skip 'finished' and 'question' notifications for turns shorter than this. 0 = always notify. Permission and error notifications ignore it.

quiet_start.title: Quiet hours start (HH:MM)
quiet_start.description: No notification at all is sent during quiet hours, not even questions or permission requests. Same start and end = quiet hours off.

quiet_end.title: Quiet hours end (HH:MM)
quiet_end.description: End of quiet hours, in this computer's local time.

include_summary.title: Include summary
include_summary.description: Send the end of Claude's last reply in the notification. Turn off to keep Claude's text out of the ntfy server.

summary_length.title: Summary length
summary_length.description: Maximum number of characters of the summary.
